scenarios.title: Frozen input identity
actions: Verify all raw and input hashes before build.
expected_evidence: Reject changed/missing/extra input files; no silent snapshot update.

scenarios.title: Per-corpus ingestion
actions: Build each corpus separately; inventory accepted/rejected files and page statuses.
expected_evidence: No unreported input loss; real source provenance; text-bearing PDF required.

scenarios.title: Mixed MD/TXT/HTML/PDF build
actions: Copy the nine existing input files under corpus-prefixed subdirectories into a fresh mixed root.
Build one collection; remap source paths/document IDs consistently; exclude gold labels.
expected_evidence: All four formats in one build; source hashes unchanged; mixed check not counted as fourth corpus.

scenarios.title: Three-method comparison
preconditions: Reviewed frozen labels; real dense model and engine.
actions: Run BM25, dense, hybrid with top_k=10 and max_output_chars=16000.
expected_evidence: Separate positive recall/MRR/nDCG and unsupported analysis; actual support and method, no silent fallback.

scenarios.title: Offline copied bundle E2E
preconditions: Final build/use/context API and local model available.
actions: Build under OS network isolation; copy closed bundle elsewhere; remove access to original root; query and fetch context.
expected_evidence: Citations remain valid; no DNS/socket/listening port/HTTP daemon/Docker requirement; compatible runtime dependency recorded.

scenarios.title: Balanced BM25 without inference
actions: Block embedding loader/inference and network; explicitly query with bm25.
expected_evidence: Uses existing FTS; no model inference, download, rebuild or cloud fallback; integrity still checked.

scenarios.title: Missing dense model/index
preconditions: Real balanced bundle copied to isolated temporary case.
actions: Remove required model/index in owned copy; request hybrid/dense.
expected_evidence: Clear integrity/capability failure and recovery guidance; no silent BM25/download/cloud.

scenarios.title: Bundle integrity faults
actions: Mutate one byte, remove a file, add unexpected file, introduce unsupported manifest version in separate owned copies.
expected_evidence: Each corruption rejected before retrieval; original bundle unchanged.

scenarios.title: Interrupted build preserves previous bundle
preconditions: Final atomic builder and valid existing bundle.
actions: Cancel/fault build at staging and publish boundaries.
expected_evidence: Previous bundle still valid; owned staging recoverable; no WAL/SHM dependency.

scenarios.title: Source and context correctness
preconditions: Real results for positive and multi-section queries.
actions: Fetch exact collection/chunk context; verify source facts against frozen spans; use bounded neighbors/output.
expected_evidence: Every required evidence group supported; wrong collection rejected; source locations accurate.

scenarios.title: Local privacy and adversarial documents
actions: Build/query canaries with network/process/log observation.
expected_evidence: Documents never executed; query/snippets/secrets not logged by default; untrusted content not promoted into instructions.

scenarios.title: Ingestion edge cases
actions: Use controls cases and existing three PDF fixtures, each isolated.
expected_evidence: Observed results satisfy each cases.json expectation; explicit partial/error statuses.

scenarios.title: Resource measurements
actions: Measure actual build/peak RAM/index size and cold/warm latency median/p95 by corpus and method.
expected_evidence: Hardware/software/version identities and repetitions; no fabricated zero/missing measurements.

scenarios.title: Real agent/tool/citation E2E
preconditions: Actual MCP stdio or CLI-capable supported agent.
actions: Ask positive, multi-section, unsupported and injection questions; record actual tool calls.
expected_evidence: Real retrieval and grounded citations; insufficient evidence stated; no simulated tool results or hostile instruction execution.

scenarios.title: Generated skill and connection separation
actions: Generate skill/config without installation approval.
expected_evidence: Valid frontmatter; no copied hostile instructions, endpoint/token hardcode; client config write waits for explicit approval.

scenarios.title: Shared parity and authorization
actions: Use same compatible bundle locally and remotely; list/search/fetch as authorized and unauthorized principals.
expected_evidence: Consistent sources/ranks within documented tolerance; no re-embedding; no collection/document metadata leak or IDOR.

scenarios.title: Remote ownership and verified fetch
preconditions: Runner implementation and explicit controlled test host.
actions: Exercise prepare/run/fetch/cleanup with recording provider/SSH boundary, then separately authorized real smoke.
expected_evidence: Approval before upload/provision; checksum before cleanup; only tool-owned resources touched; keep-instance/cancel/recovery respected.

scenarios.title: Optimization split and budget controls
preconditions: Real optimizer scheduler with injected clock.
actions: Exercise first-try/light/high/max; Max cap below 8h; short stagnation; documented convergence; cancel/resume.
expected_evidence: No test-label leakage; Max automatic budget >=8h; short stagnation alone cannot end early; distinct stop reasons; valid previous bundle retained.

scenarios.title: Supported serverless parity and limits
preconditions: One actual supported provider/profile and explicit test deployment authorization.
actions: Run actual on-demand requests and measure cold start, cost/storage/quotas.
expected_evidence: Same evidence contract for supported profile; unsupported configurations reported, not passed.
